result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide roadway with a marked continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides in a commercial district. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the crossing lacks active traffic control or speed-calming measures to protect pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any visible stop signs, traffic signals, or pedestrian-activated beacons to compel drivers to yield.

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The wide, open roadway geometry without physical narrowing or medians can encourage higher vehicle speeds in a pedestrian-heavy commercial area.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the background

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the crosswalk to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to the crosswalk to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled location.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility 'Pedestrian Crossing' warning signs to alert approaching drivers of the designated crossing point.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a signalized intersection with high-visibility zebra crosswalks and continuous sidewalks. While basic infrastructure is present, the lack of curb extensions and the presence of parked vehicles near the crossing create potential visibility issues for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side of the street can obstruct the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, immediately adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Extensions
hazards.description: The absence of bulb-outs increases the distance pedestrians must travel in the roadway and reduces their visibility to motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to ensure clear visibility for all road users.

result.summary: This urban commercial street features wide, decorative sidewalks and a high-visibility zebra crosswalk with curb ramps. Although traffic signals and street lighting are present, the crossing lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and physical speed-reduction measures like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-facing signal heads to provide safe crossing intervals.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The absence of curb extensions increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The image depicts a mixed-use urban intersection with a marked continental crosswalk and one-way traffic. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic lights are present, the environment lacks pedestrian-specific signals and suffers from poor daylighting due to parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Poor Daylighting
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on both sides of the street are positioned very close to the crosswalk, obstructing sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
